ROOT also checked a useful limitation on upgrading the old unsigned core: if H=G[S], |S|=k, is an induced subgraph of a NONBIPARTITE d-regular Ramanujan G of size n and r=2sqrt(d-1), its Perron unit vector f extended by0 gives lambda_max(A_H)<=r+(d-r)*(sum f)^2/n<=r+(d-r)*k/n. Thus an unsigned tangle with eigenvalue r+delta requires n<=(d-r)*k/delta in such a completion. Two disjoint induced copies with eigenvalue>r and NO edges between them cannot both occur: a linear combination of their Perron vectors orthogonal to1 has Rayleigh quotient>r.
